lines.zh: 我顺着亚马孙的浑水游。
lines.en: I swim through the murky Amazon water.

lines.zh: 我这副长牙，走路也露着。
lines.en: Even swimming, my long fangs show.
I travel close to the riverbed.
The current parts around my flanks.
I swim slowly past sunken logs.
One swing of my tail and I'm forward.
I weave between the roots.

lines.zh: 这群水很浑浊，正适合我。
lines.en: This water is murky; just right for me.
I move toward the shallows.
My shadow lies on the sand.
I circle this stretch of river.
I work my way upstream slowly.

lines.zh: 我停在河心，长牙朝上等。
lines.en: I hover midriver, tusks pointed upward.
My long fangs point up as I wait.
The murk keeps me from seeing far.
I listen to what moves on the surface.

lines.zh: 我这两颗牙，从下巴穿出来。
lines.en: These two fangs poke through my jaw.
The school scatter from me.
I stop beside the weeds.
This river bend is a usual haunt.
Still as sunken wood.
It's close underwater, but safe.

lines.zh: 我让水流替我保持位置。
lines.en: I let the current hold me in place.

lines.zh: 我在等什么东西掉下来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to fall in.
The light on the surface sways wildly.
I slowly let a little water out.
You stand in the water, thick-legged.
I rise and look at your feet first.

lines.zh: 我隔着水，闻到你腿上的热气。
lines.en: The heat of your legs reaches me through the water.
I turn and face you square.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在嘴外，你看清了。
lines.en: My fangs jut out; you see them clearly.
You've lingered at the river too long.
I drift up toward the surface.
You're in my stretch of river.
I stare at where your feet disturb the water.

lines.zh: 你的倒影让我很感兴趣。
lines.en: Your reflection interests me.
The payara circles behind you.
Don't thrash; water carries sound.
I lift my snout and bare my fangs.
You're bigger than any fish here.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，看着你的手。
lines.en: I tilt my head at your hands.
Your shadow falls to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我从水下看你，看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see you clearly from below.
This river isn't your ground.

lines.zh: 被撞得翻了半圈，牙还在。
lines.en: Knocked half around, but the fangs are still there.
There's pain in water too.
I flick my tail into the reeds' roots.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹少了一片银鳞。
lines.en: A silver scale is missing from my flank.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我吞进鳃里了。
lines.en: I've swallowed your scent through my gills.
I beat my tail to flee, a moment too slow.
My fangs struck something hard.
The smell of blood excites me more.
I can still swim, just crookedly.

lines.zh: 我嘴里那两颗牙，往外长。
lines.en: Two fangs jut from my lower jaw.
That's the smell of meat, isn't it.
I smell blood and my jaw opens.
Lower that thing into the water.

lines.zh: 我先闻一圈，再决定咬哪。
lines.en: I circle once to sniff, then decide where to bite.
That much won't fill one bite.

lines.zh: 我从河底的黑里升上来。
lines.en: I rise from the black of the riverbed.

lines.zh: 这条河的鱼都躲着这味道。
lines.en: The river's fish all avoid this smell.
I approach slowly, mouth open.
Let go first, and then I'll bite.
I'm almost touching it.
You stepped on me and the water splashed.

lines.zh: 我撞在你小腿上，滑开了。
lines.en: I struck your calf and slid off.

lines.zh: 我这种身子，撞了也不疼。
lines.en: A body like mine doesn't mind a knock.

lines.zh: 水里的碰撞没什么声音。
lines.en: Impacts underwater make little sound.
You've churned my water.
I slip around your leg.
Don't stomp about in the river.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，就把你推开了。
lines.en: One tail swipe pushes you off.
I take the underwater path first.
Step back and the water clears.

lines.zh: 另一条长牙的鱼靠近了。
lines.en: Another long-fanged fish draws near.
We swim upstream side by side.
Its fangs are longer than mine.
We circle among the weeds.
This bend can raise our young.
We brush scales against each other.
The murk hides us well.

lines.zh: 我和另一条长牙鱼，在浑水里并排。
lines.en: Two long-tusked fish side by side in the murk.
The schools watch from afar.
We sink slowly to the bottom.
I snatch it in my jaws.
I turn up what's sunk to the bottom.
This thing sank fast.
I bite it; it's hard.
These fangs are made for gripping fish.
Scavenging the riverbed is my skill.
It glints; I want it.

lines.zh: 我这两颗长牙，穿得过鱼。
lines.en: These two long fangs go through a fish.
This will keep me chewing a while.
I shake my head and swallow it.
That fish has caught my eye.
Its shadow moves below the surface.
That shadow belongs to my teeth now.
My fangs are starting to itch.
It swims lazily—just what I want.

lines.zh: 我贴到河底，尾鳍绷紧了。
lines.en: I drop to the riverbed, tail fin taut.
From that spot I can cut it off.
The target is past the weeds.
Today I've chosen it.
It has entered my stretch of river.
I want this one.
I turn toward it with a flick of my tail.
Has it heard me? Doesn't matter.
My long tusks split the water first.

lines.zh: 水面下有影子，我冲上去。
lines.en: There's a shadow under the surface — I lunge.
Good, that one there.
I trail behind it.

lines.zh: 它拐弯，我的鳃盖跟着转。
lines.en: When it turns, my gill covers turn too.
My fangs catch the underwater light.

lines.zh: 我离它一尾长，又逼近半尾。
lines.en: One tail-length... now half a tail-length.
I close in beneath the weeds.
It's swimming more and more frantic.
No rush; I'm faster.
Its tail beats erratically.
The murk works for me.

lines.zh: 我贴到河底，免得被发现。
lines.en: I hug the bed to stay unseen.
A little further and it's mine.
I point my snout at its belly.

lines.zh: 它每绕一次圈，我就更近。
lines.en: Each circle it makes, I draw nearer.
There's no other path in this river.

lines.zh: 我听见它的鳍在水中划。
lines.en: I hear its fins cutting water.
Patience; that's a hunter's way.
It's nearing the bank; not good.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，牙先亮出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth wide and show my teeth first.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙穿进去了。
lines.en: I bite and my fangs punch through.

lines.zh: 我的长牙是专门用来咬的。
lines.en: My long fangs are made for biting.
One ram and it flips over.

lines.zh: 我一口下去，河水全染红了。
lines.en: A mist of blood muddies the whole stretch.

lines.zh: 我甩头，牙齿撕开一道口子。
lines.en: I whip my head and my teeth tear open a gash.
It thrashes wildly in my jaws.

lines.zh: 牙嵌进肉里，我死也不松。
lines.en: My teeth are in the flesh and I won't let go.
Blood spreads in threads through the water.
After that, it can't move.
I drag it toward deeper water.
My fangs lodge in its bone.
I take one more bite.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的挣扎，一点点没了。
lines.en: Its struggle ebbs away little by little.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我们搅起来。
lines.en: We churn up the sand on the bed.
Once full, I go quiet.
The rest I leave to the river.
I surface out of the murk.
A line opens across the surface.
The fanged fish has come.
This reach of river has a new master.

lines.zh: 我的长牙从下颚穿出来。
lines.en: My fangs pierce up through my jaw.
I slip out from under the reeds.

lines.zh: 我这两根獠牙，从下颚穿出来。
lines.en: Two fangs rise from my lower jaw.
I'll explain the Amazon's rules.

lines.zh: 我的吻端破开水面，牙先出来。
lines.en: My snout breaks the surface, tusks first.
Did you hear the water?
My fangs are longer than your fingers.
I've come down from upstream.
These waters are enough for a day's swim.
I'll circle once to read the depth.
The river brought me here.

lines.zh: 别在水边洗手，我不客气。
lines.en: Don't wash your hands here; I'm not gentle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地，就到你脚边了。
lines.en: Slowly, I'm already at your feet.

lines.zh: 旱季的河，鱼都挤在一起。
lines.en: In the dry season, the fish crowd together.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，烫穿了我的鳞。
lines.en: Fire burns on the water and scorches through my scales.

lines.zh: 我被抛出水面，重重摔回去。
lines.en: I'm flung from the water and crash back down.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，居然也会呛水。
lines.en: Even this mouth of mine can choke on water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河水震得像开了锅。
lines.en: The blast makes the river boil.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my flank.

lines.zh: 这股怪力在水里追着我。
lines.en: Strange force chases me through the water.
Too hungry to beat my tail.
Lightning runs down through the river.

lines.zh: 没水，我的鳃盖死死闭着。
lines.en: No water—my gill covers clamp shut.
